text: player
Ume
Yuan Xiao
A-Yuan?
A-Yuan
Hear that, kind soul? Miss A-Yuan thinks it's too heavy for you too.
Hand over your case
Don't hand over your case
Jyanshis can say uncle too, just like how they can discard and reopen when they get a Nine Different Terminals and Honors.
Whew... Ms. Minami is such a kind person. Now we should be much faster. Hehe, roast goose, here we come!
Hehehe.
K-Kind soul... is she... possessed?
Not so far away, "A-Yuan's" hair falls away behind her as she runs, revealing a familiar pair of white rabbit ears that bob up and down before disappearing around a corner with the rest of her.
It's sweet that you'd rather believe that she's possessed than that she tricked us...
Ever since the incident at the auction house, I've been as perceptive as a detective.
Wh-What?!
Kaguyahime?!
Kaguyahime
What hustle?
That's illegal!
Well, faith is one thing, but work is another... and it's only by working hard that humans get the capital they need to maintain their faith.
Careful, Yuan Xiao! Y-Yuan Xiao...?
When I turn to warn Yuan Xiao to brace herself, her eyes are fixed on Kaguyahime's head. She's muttering something quietly with a gleam in her eyes.
I'll be back!
I look to where Yuan Xiao is pointing, and sure enough, A-Yuan is coming our way...
Seeing Yuan Xiao and me, A-Yuan lowers her head, fishes out her phone, and quickly types up something for us to read.
Ms. Fuuka sent me to help.
Trust what she has said
Can I touch your hair?
I reach out and give her hair a tug.
Tug a little harder
Seems like real hair--Trust A-Yuan
A-Yuan covers her aching head with one hand while typing rapidly on her phone with the other.
Kutsuji emerges from the convenience store.
Miss A-Yuan... is friends with someone like that? He seems...
Suspicious...
Kutsuji gestures "OK" to us with his hand, then, laughing heartily, he and "A-Yuan" get into a car together and speed off.
Wait a minute, this style is familiar... Isn't that how Noah writes?
Despite A-Yuan's offended expression, I tug on her hair again. Yuan Xiao involuntarily puts her hands over her own hair and gives her an empathetic look.
Kind soul, you're acting weird...
Yuan Xiao... Did you hear something?
Could Miss A-Yuan's hair be shouting in protest...?
Suddenly, a tearing sound cuts through the silence.
Aaahhh!! {var:Shake}
I look at A-Yuan and see her face slowly splitting apart as a deep crease extends downwards from her forehead...
Her face split down the middle, "A-Yuan" slowly closes in on us. Her lifeless eyes are locked on Yuan Xiao and me, and the corners of her mouth are upturned into a twisted smile.
She slowly hands her phone to us. The dark blue screen flickers, and an electric current buzzes softly from it. Four pallid words glare at us from the screen.
Supernatural beings want this tea too?! Just what kind of tea is this??!
Noah?
What can I say, boss?
No wonder it was so sturdy! It was one whole piece. That's what made the hair so realistic...
Kutsuji
Don't add weird random stuff to my file.
I'm afraid I must. Intel on you is expensive, and I have to ensure there's a good reason for that.
But enough with the pleasantries for now. Shall we make a trade?
What's the trade?
Have some professional integrity--Refuse!
So, answer my question first.
Is there a secret to winning mahjong every time?
There is.
What is it?
Don't play. If you never lose, you basically always win, right?
Please just answer the question!
Because we need them. No supplies are more critical to our organization.
Kutsuji's expression is sincere.
Supplies?
It's that powerful, huh...?
I would never.
Kutsuji looks appalled, even wounded.
Kutsuji's hand flies to his heart as a hurt expression forms on his face.
Feelings are bad for business.
Just then, I see Noah pass her phone to Kutsuji. Apparently, she wants him to see something. Kutsuji clicks his tongue and smiles meaningfully.
Well... It would seem you're getting more tightfisted with your intel. Fortunately, we've gotten what we needed through another channel.
Kutsuji and Noah go, leaving Yuan Xiao and I mystified...
Um... What is going on here?
Hmm. I'm not sure, but... let's get this job done first.
If you're trustworthy, then I'm Fuuka Minami--Yowch!!
Yuan Xiao pulls at my hair the way I pulled at Noah's, making me yelp with pain.
Are you wearing a mask too? Are you really Ms. Minami?
Sigh... I can't keep up with your city people's games. My head's spinning.
Kutsuji's hand flies to his heart as a hurt expression forms on his face.
After watching Kutsuji and Noah leave, Yuan Xiao and I heave long sighs.
What do you plan to do?
Eliisa
Bad Shaun! No chewing on Mr. Wolf's cases!
Tea-marinated lamb...
Bad Yuan Xiao! No thinking about eating Shaun!
Haruna Igarashi
Don't just stop and play with it!
Thank you so much! Huh? This case... smells a little funny.
I guess we were in such a rush, we didn't look where we put it.
No matter how unique a tea is... somebody will always enjoy it...
Exhausted, Yuan Xiao and I are finally outside Bamboo Cloud. But then we hear a familiar voice.
Half a day passes by in the blink of an eye
A-Yuan again! {var:ShakeScene}
It's Miss A-Yuan again!{var:Shake}
Again?
Hold it right there--I have some questions for you!
What color do you usually wear?
Hm... Red, I guess.
Next question: What do you usually eat?
Asking me this question in a place Ms. Fuuka can see... How are you expecting me to answer? Heh! Heh!
...You're acting really strange. Did something happen?
It's a long story, but long story short, you're the third Miss A-Yuan we've run into today!
I see... So, you suspect that I may not be the real A-Yuan?
A-Yuan looks helplessly at us, then lowers her head in serious thought.
Yuan Xiao and I look at each other--We can't get complacent now! We keep holding on tight to the boxes.
Ms. Fuuka has been with me all day. Looks like she's the only one that can prove that I'm the real A-Yuan.
A short while later, Ume appears and takes Yuan Xiao and me to see Fuuka Minami.
Yuan Xiao and I take turns filling Fuuka Minami in on everything that happened to us on our way to Bamboo Cloud.
Fuuka Minami
Looking at me with a smile, Fuuka Minami closes her fan and stands up.
Then why--
The tea association?
You mean, they wanted to flood the market before Bamboo Cloud's anniversary banquet?
I'm not.
I-I wouldn't dream of it. You're getting... quite close to me...
Ume is sitting next to him. The corners of her mouth raise slightly when she sees our somewhat disheveled state, like she's trying to keep from laughing.
Ume and Yuan Xiao go, leaving the huge courtyard to just Fei Ming and me.
Looking at his stoic expression, I wonder... could there be some sort of secret in this boiled water?
I take a small sip.
Fei Ming
Then... what did Ms. Minami see that day?
Wait a minute! Hey! You're going to go give the competition your money, are you?! Where did I fall short??
I feel a little nervous as I hold this precious cup in my hands.
This is like a cultural relic. You're not worried I'll damage it?
Fei Ming smiles. He rolls up his sleeves and prepares to leave.
After Fei Ming gathers his things and leaves, I continue to sit alone in the courtyard, holding the precious cup in my hands, until Yuan Xiao comes charging back.
Kind soul! We did all that work for nothing!
What? Then the tea we delivered...
Why didn't they tell us any of this before?! I'm so mad!
At least we'll still get our usual paychecks. As for the work itself... we just have to do what our bosses tell us to. Try not to take it so hard.
Hearing this, Yuan Xiao slowly looks up at me. Pity and sympathy fill her eyes.
Huh? Hey, kind soul! You shouldn't take it so hard either!
Kind soul...
There are traffic jams all over Champion Street today. I can't even get a cab... Yep, I've got... four cases of tea samples. Magical Dream says that the boss arranged for them last night.
One law of the workplace has become increasingly clear to me recently: No plan can keep up with the boss's whims.
I had been under the impression that these "tea samples" would be no different from the kind you'd find in a shop--a small box containing two to three servings.

But when I arrived at Magical Dream bright and early this morning, I was greeted by four cases more than ten inches thick sit neatly side by side. I realized then just how naive I was to the grueling reality of working life.
Right, I think I understand the situation. Magical Dream isn't terribly far from Bamboo Cloud HQ, at least. I'll have to ask you to walk back.
And so, Yuan Xiao and I are left with no choice but to escort the tea on its journey west to Bamboo Cloud.
You'd better pick up the pace, kind soul! We can still make it before lunch. Otherwise, we'll be stuck waiting in line for roast goose later.
And you could slow down! How are you able to walk so fast while carrying two huge cases of tea?

Well... hehe, I often used to go up the mountain to dig for bamboo shoots, and those were way heavier than tea leaves. Besides, where I come from, even a child could carry these! Why, too heavy for you?
I never said that... Anyway, are you sure your boss didn't stick rocks in these cases? There's no way tea leaves are this heavy. I...
Finally, I've found you guys.
Our walk-and-talk is suddenly interrupted when a familiar figure comes around the corner.
Ahem... the boss told me to come meet you two and see if you needed any help.
Grinning, A-Yuan looks at Yuan Xiao and me and spreads her arms out.
That's a lot of tea! Let me take one of those cases off your hands. We wouldn't want {var:player_nickname} to die of exhaustion.
Then I'll let you handle this Nine Different--I mean, this case of tea. Thanks, A-Yuan.
Our faces light up with joy as A-Yuan takes a case. Her face light up, too... and she even starts to laugh.
After flashing us an odd, but gleaming smile, she immediately turns on her heels and runs off...
But... why would she want to steal our tea?
Anyone else could have any number of reasons. But when it comes to Kaguyahime... she wants to see the world burn, I'm afraid.
You know, I've been meaning to ask you... where is your voice coming from?
Your mouth is moving, but your voice is coming from the bow on your chest! So, there's only one truth--
Before "A-Yuan" can react, I quickly reach out and give the top of her head a light tug--lifting the high-quality wig now firmly in my grasp right off her head.
D-Damn it. I underestimated you, human. I never imagined that, in just a few days, you would have already evolved enough to see through my disguise...
But... why would you want to steal our tea?
Hehehe! How could mere mortals comprehend a goddess's designs?
However, since you've proven yourself to be a worthy devotee, {var:player_nickname}, I'll let you in on the hustle as well.
The hustle of obtaining Bamboo Cloud's trade secrets and selling them to the highest bidder... Hehehe, and you're free to author said secrets at your discretion, of course.
Hmph! So, you refuse to cooperate with me! Is this how my most loyal follower should behave?
Her offer rebuffed, Kaguyahime's embarrassment gives way to anger. Her ears stand straight up as she readies herself to pounce.
Dry pot rabbit, braised rabbit, stir-fried rabbit, two-chili rabbit, cold-served rabbit...
Obviously hearing this as well, Kaguyahime's face pales and her ears twist into a knot. She pulls her hands back and goes to make a hasty retreat, but not before shouting one last thing at us.
After this incident with Kaguyahime, we begin taking our tea delivery even more seriously. With careful steps, we walk another half a block.
Hold on a minute, am I hallucinating? Is that Miss A-Yuan... again?
I lost my voice after an intense rehearsal, so let's communicate this way.
I can't put my finger on it, but something about this writing style is familiar...
Remembering the rabbit ears under the wig from earlier, I make a request...
A-Yuan looks puzzled, but seeing how serious I am, she reluctantly types a single word into her phone.
...Okay.
Alright, here I go then!
Okay, it's soft to the touch and warm and silky near her scalp. Seems like real hair!
More importantly, I can clearly see the pain in her eyes, and her hair isn't budging.
Excuse me! How could you yank a girl's hair like that?
I quickly step back and apologize.
We just met a fake A-Yuan, so I wasn't sure if it was really you... I'm sorry if I offended you!
Apology accepted, for now...
Yuan Xiao and I hand her the tea. But to our surprise, A-Yuan then turns and runs off to the nearby convenience store. And then...
What the heck are you doing???! [○･｀Д´･ ○]

Just when I gather the courage to give her hair another pull, I hear a faint crackling sound in the air. The silence permeating the area around us only intensifies the hubbub of the surrounding streets.
Aaahhh!! {var:ShakeScene}
Unable to believe our eyes, Yuan Xiao and I stumble backward while clutching the tea tightly in our hands.
"Hand over. The tea."

We obviously can't give her the tea like this, but just when Yuan Xiao and I are about to turn and make a run for it, I suddenly realize that a familiar face is coming into view as "A-Yuan's" splits apart...
Kutsuji emerges from the nearby convenience store. He reaches out and pulls a full-coverage mask from Noah's head.
I never imagined you'd be so rough with our local celebrity. Tsk tsk, I'll be making a note in your dossier after this: "Not above harming the beauty."
A piece of intel for a bag of tea.
With this many bags, who's gonna notice if one goes missing? Agree to it!
Kutsuji's intel is always expensive, this much I do know. I look at the case in my hands--It can't be worth the price of his intel, surely...?
Why do you guys want this tea too?
When you insist on playing, you face the four inevitable stages of mahjong: a good starting hand, an ever-elusive Tenpai, ending in disappointment, and just one more game.
But why would you want to win constantly anyway? Mahjong's like life--the fun lies in the uncertainty of it all! After all, who among us hasn't been enchanted by a dream of hitting the jackpot?
"Too"...? An interesting choice of word.
That's right. This tea can boost your mental performance all day long and heighten your senses. How else do you think we located you two?
The concealed weapons we use are also made from this tea. Perhaps you've heard of the lost "Jyanshi Flying Dagger" technique? Just one "Woosh--!" and it splits them like a leaf.
These tea leaves don't cut your throat when you drink them, right? Wait a minute... You're not messing with me, are you?
Why don't you give the tea to me, and I'll show you?
You're trying to pull one over on me. I'm not so naive a Jyanshi that I'd believe you'd really trade your intel for a box of tea.
When one side loses trust, it can never again be recovered.
And so, we'll leave things off here. Until next time, boss.
...It was a figure of speech!
Kutsuji is an expert at psychological warfare. After turning him down, I cautiously pull Yuan Xiao back a few steps just in case he has any more tricks up his sleeve.
When one side loses trust, it can never again be recovered.
To strengthen the trust between us, I'll let you in on a little secret--free of charge.
Be wary of everyone you meet on this street. Information on which tea was chosen for Bamboo Cloud's anniversary banquet is an extremely hot commodity right now.
...Is it really a good idea for us to be responsible for such an important trade secret?
There's nothing to worry about, kind soul! If that's the case... Hehe!
If our adversaries won't listen to reason, maybe they'll listen to my fists.
Just promise me you won't be too rough on them. We've never had a bloodletting in One Han City before.
What takes us by surprise, however... is how much more than we bargained for this tea delivery has ended up being.
No, kitty! Spit that out! That's not catnip!
...Can we see again how that cat opened up my case with its paw pads?
Wow! Such a chubby orange cat! C'mere kitty, pspsps.
Eve Krist
Relax, no one touched this case when you two went running off just now.
Oh! I was looking everywhere for the stinky tofu daifuku I just bought. It was flattened under the box!
Oh no! The smell got into the tea leaves too...
There you are! Ms. Fuuka asked me to meet you guys.
Huh? Okay then, shoot.
(whisper) Really?
(whisper) I don't know, but anything goes right now!
You may have a point there...
Muttering something like, "Why do I have to prove that I'm me?" A-Yuan leaves. Yuan Xiao and I sigh, then wait for her to return.
You have not had an easy time of it. Thank you both for your hard work.
A-Yuan, take Yuan Xiao back to Mr. Fei Ming and report the situation to him.
As for you... come with me.
When I enter her office, several wooden boxes with the words "Magical Dream" stamped on them greet me from her desk.
Huh? That doesn't look like the tea Yuan Xiao and I delivered...
It's not. These are the real tea samples. You two just transported some of their signature teas.
The mantis stalks the cicada, unaware of the oriole behind.
Fuuka Minami's smile recedes. She looks out the window and taps her palm with her fan.
Yesterday, Ume found out that someone's been spreading rumors. She traced them back to the source, and...
That's right.

More and more people want to get a piece of the business on Champion Street... I wonder if the last few years of marketing Bamboo Cloud as a friendly, accessible brand has given them the wrong impression?
Fuuka Minami pauses for a moment, and her mouth curls into a faint sneer. She turns her head back to me and continues speaking nonchalantly.
When the little ants realized they'd been found out, they were so rattled that they actually planned to steal the tea from us.
Not bad, you're getting the hang of this. It was a brilliant idea, really. It would have turned Bamboo Cloud's anniversary celebration into a complete joke... but they overestimated their abilities.
Thanks to you and the girl from the tea house serving as our decoy today, and to the people Ume put on the task, I believe our ant problem has been taken care of.
If they fell for that, they're no match for you. But... who am I to say anything? After all, I was also completely in the dark until now.
You're upset.
Fuuka Minami leans in and pokes the corner of my mouth with her finger.
You're frowning.
Ume told me you'd get angry if I didn't tell you first. Looks like she was right...
Fuuka Minami takes out a gorgeous wine goblet inlaid with precious stones and hands it to me with a smile.
Fortunately, I prepared an apology gift.
This goblet is one of a pair that I've had for many years. I'll give you this one in exchange for your forgiveness. Deal?
Do you think I'm the kind of person that can be bought with gifts?
Not good enough? What if I also treat you to dinner for a week?
Uh... You're not planning on giving me a Bamboo Cloud weekly buffet pass or something like that, are you?
Sigh... Ume was right--People are easier to anger than they are to placate.
I won't just be covering your dinner costs--I'll be turning down several meetings each day so that I can take you to dinner myself. You wouldn't turn down my invitation, would you, MY DEAR SECRETARY?
Fuuka Minami is smiling, but this last sentence seems to be forced through gritted teeth. Being the honest worker that I am, I...
Okay, it's settled then. We'll begin tonight.
Memento Received: Precious Goblet
Anyway... this tea delivery is far more than we bargained for.
In the end, the only way Yuan Xiao and I can evade Chihori Terasaki's camera and questions is by climbing over the wall and into Bamboo Cloud's rear court.
As soon as we land, we see Fei Ming sitting in the garden and holding a teapot. As if wholly unsurprised by our entrance, he continues pouring without missing a beat.
Yuan Xiao, would you please check over the tea samples with me?
{var:player_nickname}, you can stay here and entertain our guest.
To break the silence, I pluck up the courage to ask him the question.
Mr. Fei Ming, what tea did you give Ms. Minami that day?
Without answering, he pours out the tea in front of me and fills it with boiled water. He then hands it back to me.
Isn't this just... plain boiled water?
He shakes his head, then pours boiled water into his own cup as well.
If you think it's water, then it's water. If you think it's tea, then it's tea.
You mean, tea is just a vibe?
Heh, it's just a label for it, nothing more. What you see, think, and understand in the moment you're drinking it, as well as what you think it should be, all make it what it is.
You'll have to ask her yourself. How would a bystander know what she glimpsed in her cup?
Or...
Fei Ming taps his cup with his finger and scans over me with his eyes.
One day, when you earn the privilege of being an honored guest on Magical Dream's third floor... you'll understand.
Magical Dream's third floor... I'm suddenly taken back to my conversation with Kutsuji earlier...
Is Strix the only intelligence organization in One Han City?
That depends on your definition. If trading in information is all it takes to be an intelligence organization, then... heh, Magical Dream counts as one too.
Magical Dream?

That tea house on Champion Street. They say the people that go to the third floor all come out in a daze, like empty shells of themselves. I bet they saw something their minds couldn't handle. But you wouldn't believe something like that, would you?
Without saying another word, Fei Ming gets to his feet. He picks up an unused cup from the antique tea set and hands it to me.
This tea set is from Magical Dream's collection, it's been around for quite some time now. Destiny brought you and the tea house together, and that's earned you this teacup. Until we meet again.
Since you were destined to be brought together, its fate is in your hands now.
What happened? Is there something wrong with the tea?
No... there's something wrong with my boss! He brought the tea samples here himself, that's why he was already here!
Your boss ordered a few boxes of the most expensive tea we have! So much for everything being above board while they gave us the runaround...
Seeing how frustrated Yuan Xiao is, I hastily reach out and offer her a comforting pat on the shoulder.
But Ms. Minami said that the cost of the damage to the tea bags will be deducted from your salary...
Memento Received: Teacup From Fei Ming
